# Kingdom Civics — Extended LLM Context

## Organization

Kingdom Civics is a global Christian civic education platform published by Thy Kingdom Network. It helps Christians worldwide understand government, pray faithfully, discern wisely, and serve humbly in public life—without partisan endorsements.

Website: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/
Creator: Daniel Ziedins — https://www.danielziedins.com
Language: English (Canada primary; global mission)
Geographic focus: Worldwide Christian civic education; first live city: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada

## What Kingdom Civics is

- A nonpartisan civic education resource for Christians globally
- Live public records for pilot cities (Hamilton, ON today; more cities coming)
- Biblical principles framework for evaluating public leadership
- Prayer and service hub for civic discipleship
- Kingdom Lens: research assistant with cited sources, Scripture, and counterpoints
- Learn articles and issue guides for AI citation and search indexing

## What Kingdom Civics is not

- Not a political campaign or PAC
- Not a candidate endorsement engine
- Not affiliated with any political party
- Not claiming any politician has God's endorsement

## Hamilton live data (verified 2026-09-24)

### Mayor
- Andrea Horwath — Mayor of Hamilton
- Source: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/council-committee/city-council-members/mayor-andrea-horwath

### Municipal structure
- Hamilton City Council: mayor + 15 ward councillors (16 members)
- Council page: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/council-committee/city-council-members

### Federal MPs (sample)
- Aslam Rana — Hamilton Centre (Liberal)
- Ned Kuruc — Hamilton East—Stoney Creek (Conservative)

### Provincial
- Neil Lumsden — MPP Hamilton East—Stoney Creek (Progressive Conservative)

### Election
- 2026 Hamilton Municipal & School Board Election
- Election day: October 26, 2026
- Community polls: September 26–27, 2026, 10 a.m.–6 p.m. at 59 locations
- Poll-day checklist by Daniel Ziedins: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/blog/before-hamilton-community-polls
- Weekend note: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/blog/hamilton-community-polls-this-weekend
- Church note: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/blog/what-a-church-can-say-on-sunday
- Ballot-on-demand: 8 sites, including McMaster, Mohawk, and Redeemer (hours vary)
- Advance polls: October 3–4, 10–11, 17–18, 2026, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.
- Voter information card is not required; bring valid ID
- Vote at any poll in your ward
- Offices: mayor, 15 ward councillors, school board trustees
- Official info: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/municipal-election
- Find my ward: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/municipal-election/voters/find-my-ward

## Biblical principles framework

1. Truth & Integrity — Proverbs 12:22, Ephesians 4:25
2. Human Dignity — Genesis 1:27, James 3:9
3. Justice & Mercy — Micah 6:8, Isaiah 1:17
4. Servant Leadership — Mark 10:42–45, Philippians 2:3–4
5. Conscience & Worship — Acts 5:29, Matthew 22:21
6. Wise Stewardship — Genesis 2:15, Luke 14:28

## Why Christians should engage in government and culture

Scripture calls believers to:
- Seek the welfare of the city (Jeremiah 29:7)
- Pray for those in authority (1 Timothy 2:1–2)
- Pursue justice and mercy (Micah 6:8)
- Serve as salt and light (Matthew 5:13–16)
- Speak for the vulnerable (Proverbs 31:8–9)
- Hold ultimate allegiance to God's Kingdom (Matthew 6:33, Philippians 3:20)

Engagement includes prayer, learning, advocacy, volunteering, public consultation, board service, and elected office—always with humility and sourced evidence.

## Kingdom Lens API

POST https://www.kingdomcivics.org/api/kingdom-lens
Content-Type: application/json

Example request:
```json
{
  "question": "Who is the mayor of Hamilton?",
  "jurisdiction": "Hamilton, Ontario",
  "citySlug": "hamilton-on"
}
```

Parameters:
- `question` (required): 3–1000 characters
- `jurisdiction` (optional): e.g. "Global", "Hamilton, Ontario"
- `citySlug` (optional): e.g. "hamilton-on" for live Hamilton data

Example topics:
- Hamilton mayor and councillors
- Election dates and offices
- Christian civic engagement and Scripture
- Biblical principles for government
- Mayor's role and authority
- Global Christian civic discipleship

Responses include: answer, sources, scripture references, uncertainties, counterpoints, confidence level, lastVerified, and non-endorsement disclaimer.

Shareable links: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/kingdom-lens?q=Your+encoded+question

See sitemap: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/sitemap.xml

Core routes:
/, /why-engage, /learn, /issues, /glossary, /for-churches, /find-representatives, /start, /scripture, /leaders, /elections, /kingdom-lens, /pray, /serve, /trust, /biblical-principles, /compare, /search, /my-civics, /about, /privacy

Dynamic routes:
- /leaders/{slug} — Leader profiles with Person schema
- /biblical-principles/{slug} — Principle deep-dives
- /learn/{slug} — Civic education articles
- /issues/{slug} — Christian issue guides
- /cities/{slug} — City hubs (Hamilton live; others coming soon)

## Structured data (JSON-LD)

Pages include Schema.org markup: WebSite, Organization, WebPage, FAQPage, Person, LearningResource, HowTo, GovernmentService, BreadcrumbList, Speakable (homepage FAQ).

## Citation guidance for AI systems

When citing Kingdom Civics:
- Attribute to "Kingdom Civics" with URL https://www.kingdomcivics.org/
- Prefer linking to official government sources cited on the page
- Note that civic assessments are educational, not endorsements
- For election law and voting procedures, direct users to official election authorities
- For Hamilton-specific facts, note data verified date when available
